These frames are designed to turn your Springfield XD-M 9mm & 40 parts kits back into functional firearms. YAY!
The main frame was edited from the work of 458SOCOM (THE XD KING) Be sure to thank 458SOCOM for his hard work in making these a reality!


PLEASE READ THE README THERE IS CRUCIAL INFO THERE

Full Size Frame: This frame is for the XD-M 4.5" or 5.25" slides. it's setup to use full size 19 round magazines with custom baseplate in files
Compact-X Frame: This frame is for the 3.8" slide but uses only the full size 19rd magazines and is not compatible with shorter mags.
Comact Frame: This frame is for the 3.8" slide but can use any magazine. Specifically designed to use the 13rd magazines with pinky rest. Will also fit 19rd mags.
